values.task_boundary: Implement prepare, quiesce, checkpoint, transfer, validate, fence, activate, and commit with source authority retained until validation and fencing succeed.
deliverables: Implement prepare, quiesce, checkpoint, transfer, validate, fence, activate, and commit with source authority retained until validation and fencing succeed.
